thread:
rachel: Quick heads-up — noticed webinar leads showing as unassigned in HubSpot after SF sync. Looks like owner hints baked into the form are stale and SF rejects them.
dan: any logs?
rachel: small excerpt from sync middleware:
[1798887777] hs->sf sync lead=wb-11 email=alex@ex.com owner_hint=usr_482
[1798887780] sf response 400 {"message": "OwnerId invalid: user not active"}
[1798887781] sync logic wrote owner=null and persisted -> dashboard shows unowned
sam: ok that explains it. Two fixes: (1) make sync resilient — if SF Owner validation fails, call HS RR assign and retry upsert; (2) stop embedding concrete owner ids in the webinar form template, use owner_hint only.
aaron: i'd prioritize a quick middleware hotfix so we don't miss next webinar. Can you implement a sync handler that on SF 400 with owner error will call hs.assign_round_robin() synchronously, then retry SF upsert once? Keep it blocking for up to 1s.
dan: i can ship the hotfix. i'll add metrics: metric.webinar.sf_owner_validation{outcome=stashed|reassigned|failed}. Create an alert if failed_rate > 0.5% of webinar traffic.
rachel: also add a cron to scan for deactivated SF users referenced by owner_hints and mark those forms for template update.
sam: fwk test: simulate sf 400 + ensure hs RR assigns within 2s and upsert succeeds. Add smoke canary: enable hotfix for US-east webinars only for 4h, watch unowned_rate.
jira-bot: Ticket MARK-1122 created for middleware hotfix and template audit.
aaron: timeline: dan opens PR in next 30m, canary tomorrow morning, roll full after 4h if metrics stable.
rachel: perfect. i'll update the webinar runbook and ping SalesOps to refresh if they see a temporary delay. :thumbsup:
